response.reason: The three generic structures each test a single metric (accurate_crosses or big_chances) in isolation under HOME + SIMILAR_OPPONENT_COHORT. Candidate C8 is structurally distinct in two ways: (1) it tests accurate_crosses and big_chances jointly as a coupled defensive suppression signal — the mechanism requires both to move together, not either one alone; (2) it introduces a two-sided interaction by anchoring the similar-opponent cohort to TEAM_B's own away crossing output, making the cohort definition opponent-profile-motivated rather than generic. GEN_0136008 and GEN_0136010 cover the individual metrics at ALL_PRIOR; GEN_0136032 covers accurate_crosses at W5. None of the three generics combine both metrics nor condition the cohort on the opponent's own attacking profile axis. The joint-metric coupling and the opponent-profile motivation together constitute incremental structure beyond what the generics test.
